answer.evidence: The roof at x=40 is a lighter blue band with glare, rows 5-16, and it ends in a dark front-edge line at row 17. Grey-blue side-window rows 18-24 and the door and body panel rows 25-37 sit below it as the south face, with the wheels at rows 33-45. The hood and trunk decks at rows 13-24 are also lit horizontal planes. The width profile widens from 21 px at row 5 to 74 px by row 15, which fits a roof and deck surface seen from above. The car faces left but is not a flat side profile, because the top planes are visible.

styleAnswer.evidence: The car body is a mid blue with one lighter highlight and one darker lower shade, so about 3 steps on the main ramp against the references' 5-6. The outline is a dark navy-black line around the whole silhouette and the windows. 89% of the dark edge pixels are near-neutral, versus 0-44% for most references, so it reads as a sticker outline rather than a dark tone of the adjacent material. The panels (hood, roof, door, lower body) are large smooth areas with little grain, dirt, speckle or per-part shading. Flat coverage is 14%, close to the cheese stall's 13%, but the stall has many small distinct elements and the car does not. At 9 visible tones per tile the car matches the hedge but is well below the well (20) and the stall (17). It is competent but shallower and more sticker-like than the references.
